notes: These vectors pin CBA dual-plane semantics. DataEvent vectors use signed kind + payload + scope_ref + seal_ref and never use preconditions. Control Move vectors use signed kind + payload + scope_ref + seal_basis and may use preconditions. Every cell write is receiver-projected from the registered reducer contract.

Seal delta entries reference only newly sealed control-plane event digests. Cumulative coverage is derived from predecessor_refs[] plus delta[]. DataEvent digests may appear in data_event_set_root / data_view_root observations, but those roots do not confer control-plane finality.
Cell ids follow ak:cell:ak.component.<facet-path>.v<n>:<subject>; subject placeholders use dot-safe strings to keep examples unambiguous.

lattice_round_trip.description: SDK lattice round-trip runner coverage for CBA lattice family vectors exercised through any conforming local lattice implementation.

assertions: a single maximal supersession chain resolves to its terminal value
same-from divergent successors resolve to bottom
a dangling non-initial supersession resolves to bottom

vectors.name: data_event_accepts_without_seal_finality
vectors.description: A message DataEvent is locally accepted when signature, actor chain, seal_ref, auth_context, capability and data-plane Lattice validation pass. It does not wait for Seal coverage.

vectors.name: data_event_observation_does_not_seal
vectors.description: A Seal may observe DataEvents through data_event_set_root, but that observation is evidence, not control-plane finality.

vectors.name: control_move_requires_seal_basis_and_seal
vectors.description: A membership ban Control Move uses seal_basis for authorization and preconditions. It remains control_pending until covered by a valid Seal.

vectors.name: same_batch_does_not_advance_authorization_basis
vectors.description: An Event earlier in the same submit batch may resolve bytes and causal refs for later Events, but it cannot create a grant used by a later Event in the same batch.

vectors.name: data_plane_conflict_returns_bottom_without_winner
vectors.description: Concurrent incompatible writes to a data-plane cas_register cell return structured bottom. The reducer must not choose a winner by HLC, actor id, arrival order, or Seal observation order.

vectors.name: seal_delta_excludes_data_event_digest
vectors.description: A Seal delta contains newly sealed control-plane event digests only. Including a DataEvent digest in delta is a seal validation failure.

vectors.name: open_set_compaction_preserves_control_roots
vectors.description: A signed compaction Seal must be equivalent to the deterministic control view of its predecessors and preserve control_event_set_root, state_root and fault diagnostics.

vectors.name: seal_canonical_no_self_reference
vectors.description: Seal canonical bytes are computed from signed top-level body fields only. The Seal id and notary_signature are excluded from the transcript.

vectors.name: cas_mixed_basis
vectors.description: cas_register writes on a non-initial settled value require an explicit CBA basis; null-basis blind overwrites fail closed.

expected.note: Per event-auth-state-resolution.md section 9.3.1 the projector copies the whole-value head_eq into op.from, so the join sees the v1 -> v2 supersession chain and settles on v2 instead of bottom. The blind write above deliberately has no from: it forms a second chain head and the defensive join stays bottom.

vectors.name: auth_context_epoch_pinning_reject
vectors.description: Verifier evaluates key and credential epoch validity at the event seal_ref, not only against the current DID document.

vectors.name: seal_compaction_interval_enforced
vectors.description: Realm seal_compaction_max_interval_ms is a structural obligation: valid full-coverage compaction enables bootstrap, mismatched coverage rejects, and overdue compaction raises health alarms.

vectors.name: inclusion_list_obligation
vectors.description: A multi-signer notary Seal must discharge valid inclusion-list obligations by inclusion, signed reject, or pre-state verification failure proof.

vectors.name: notary_fault_equivocation_quarantine
vectors.description: Two different Seals signed by the same notary in the same slot authorize public equivocation evidence, quarantine the fork, and reject later Seals from that signer.

vectors.name: sealed_control_move_full_digest_collision
vectors.description: Two different canonical preimages recompute to the same event_id under one suite, and the colliding Control Move is already covered by an accepted Seal. Unlike notary equivocation, the sibling event_digest values are byte-identical, so no digest can name the winner.

colliding_identity.note: variant_a and variant_b share this event_id and event_digest byte for byte

resolution_cases.name: resolution_names_winner_by_variant_record_reference
resolution_cases.description: An original Event close to the 1 MiB ceiling cannot be inlined twice, so the collision is adjudicated through the registered governance-dependency record.

resolution_cases.name: resolution_voids_complete_sibling_position
resolution_cases.description: Single-bucket overflow proves itself with exactly 17 siblings; the verdict governs the whole position, not the bucket.

resolution_cases.name: resolution_cross_bucket_overflow_uses_sixty_five_siblings
resolution_cases.description: Cross-bucket overflow needs 65 siblings and projects onto the same position cell as the single-bucket case.

resolution_cases.name: resolution_bucket_overflow_below_minimal_evidence_rejected
resolution_cases.description: 16 siblings are legal under the v1 ceiling, so they do not prove an overflow.

resolution_cases.name: resolution_subject_carrying_bucket_digest_rejected
resolution_cases.description: prev_frontier_digest inside the subject would split one position into two conflicting resolution cells.

resolution_cases.name: resolution_without_peer_alignment_does_not_clear_peer
resolution_cases.description: Local normalization and per-peer alignment are separate phases; an accepted resolution alone never clears peer_stale.

resolution_cases.name: resolution_state_witness_role_rejected
resolution_cases.description: state_witness attests a cell's legal value before Bottom; the fork-resolution cell is __unset__ before its first write, so the role has no referent here.

resolution_cases.name: cross_suite_discriminator_is_diagnostic_only
resolution_cases.note: blake3 is profile-gated v1_optional_interop, so a peer may be unable to verify it

vectors.name: threshold_forensic_attribution
vectors.description: Threshold notary forensic_attribution must match the quorum-intersection arithmetic rule.

vectors.name: open_set_concurrent_revocation_fail_closed
vectors.description: A DataEvent whose seal_ref is locally valid is re-evaluated against the joined multi-leaf control view when a concurrent revocation branch is observed.

cases.name: late_revocation_leaf_retroactive_removal
cases.description: Ordered sequence, not a single joined-view snapshot: E is first accepted and its reducer-projected write is materialized into data cell X under the initial joined view that has NOT yet joined the revoke leaf R. Dependent event D is then accepted with E as a critical causal dependency and materializes a projected write into data cell Y. R arrives later; once joined, E loses seal_ref authorization, so E and the complete direct/indirect dependency closure rooted at E MUST leave accepted projection inputs. The final state MUST equal that of a receiver that joined {S0,R} from the start, independent of arrival order.

vectors.name: actor_chain_realm_scope
vectors.description: Actor sequence and sibling detection are scoped to (realm_id, actor_id); equal actor_seq values in different Realms do not create a fork.

vectors.name: conflict_recovery_move
vectors.description: A bottom=reject control cell recovers only through a sealed ak.conflict.recovery Control Move with recovery_capability and a pre-conflict state_witness. The recovered value is the signed payload.resolved_value, projected by the registered cell_ref + reset form; no other kind may declare that form.

expected.note: reset is legal only on a cell already in bottom; on any other state the write is rejected, so recovery cannot be used as a general overwrite channel.
the state_witness must witness the cell named by payload.target_cell_id; witnessing a different cell proves nothing about the one being reset.

target_cell_id is the only registered payload field (NC-IDROLE-001); the retired target_cell alias is an unknown property under additionalProperties:false and the required target_cell_id is absent, so the Move never reaches recovery evaluation.
carrying both target_cell_id and the retired alias is a schema violation; a receiver MUST NOT pick either field or reconcile them.

vectors.name: same_seal_bottom_reject_serialization
vectors.description: Notary admission serializes mutually exclusive writes to one bottom=reject cell within a single proposed Seal, while preserving bottom semantics across unreachable Seal leaves.

vectors.name: realm_alias_single_carrier
vectors.description: A Realm alias has exactly one wire carrier. ak.realm.alias sets ak.component.realm.alias.v1 (cas_register, cell_subject=null, bottom=reject); the closed realm genesis/profile objects carry no alias, and no implementation may keep a fallback input chain over several shapes.

expected.create_time_alias_shape: registered conditional alias slot in the same ordered atomic Realm bootstrap unit
expected.rename_shape: successor set on the same cell carrying whole-value head_eq
expected.release_shape: explicit {tombstone:true} set; effective resolution treats it as absence and the Realm stays addressable only by realm_id
expected.resolution_source: resolve_realm / resolve_target / ak.edge.applet.realm.read.resolve.v1 read the effective cell; directory rows are a projection, not a second source of truth

negative_cases.name: alias_on_realm_object
negative_cases.expected: schema_violation (realm.schema.json is closed and explicitly forbids alias)

negative_cases.name: alias_at_payload_top_level
negative_cases.mutation: a Realm lifecycle Event carries payload.alias or payload.realm_alias

negative_cases.name: foreign_authority_domain
negative_cases.mutation: declaration alias domain is not an authority domain of this Realm trust_domain

negative_cases.name: alias_held_by_another_realm
negative_cases.mutation: declare a canonical alias already held by a different Realm in the same authority realm-alias namespace
negative_cases.expected: failed_precondition with reason realm_alias_taken; the alias MUST NOT be re-pointed and the holder MUST tombstone first

negative_cases.name: same_string_occupied_in_handle_namespace
negative_cases.mutation: declare an alias whose canonical string is an existing handle at the same authority
negative_cases.expected: accepted; the handle and realm-alias namespaces are disjoint and no cross-registry uniqueness check exists

negative_cases.name: concurrent_distinct_alias_declarations
negative_cases.mutation: two mutually unreachable ak.realm.alias set Moves declare different aliases for the same Realm
negative_cases.expected: bottom_conflict (cas_register bottom=reject); resolution fails closed instead of picking a winner

negative_cases.name: alias_in_principal_control_realm
negative_cases.mutation: submit ak.realm.alias into a Principal Control Realm
negative_cases.expected: principal_control_event_kind_forbidden (the kind is absent from the PCR allowlist)

vectors.name: realm_create_projection_closure
vectors.description: ak.realm.create deterministically projects five unconditional registered writes plus every registry condition that matches, while profile and membership remain explicit ordered bootstrap facets, so two independent implementations recompute a byte-identical genesis state_root without producer-supplied reducer state.

expected.creator_member_cell_proof: inclusion from the explicit final ak.member.state bootstrap facet

negative_cases.name: implicit_member_state_projection
negative_cases.mutation: implement create reducer with an unregistered ak.component.member.state.v1 projected write
negative_cases.expected: state_root differs from the positive case and apply_seal step 11 rejects with rejected_seal

negative_cases.name: profile_cell_after_bootstrap
negative_cases.mutation: omit the required profile facet from the atomic bootstrap unit and write it later

negative_cases.name: extra_unregistered_projection
negative_cases.mutation: implement a reducer that adds a sixth projected write not present in cell_writes[]

vectors.name: null_cell_subject_wire_form
vectors.description: Every cell family declared with cell_subject: null uses the literal ASCII subject segment null, so the state_root leaf set and leaf order are identical across implementations.

negative_cases.name: realm_id_encoded_into_subject
negative_cases.bad_subject_segment: the Realm id of the Event envelope

negative_cases.name: realm_role_classification_encoded_into_subject
negative_cases.bad_subject_segment: a prose-layer Realm role term such as collaboration or principal_control

negative_cases.name: empty_trailing_segment
negative_cases.bad_subject_segment: the empty string (indistinguishable from a truncated wire id)
